title: S&P 500 drops 4.4% in its worst day since April 2025
summary: A sharp sell-off in AI stocks pulled the whole US market down on Thursday. The S&P 500 fell 4.4%, its biggest one day drop since the tariff shock of April 2025, just a day after Wednesday's rally.
why: The S&P 500 is a list of 500 big US companies, so when it falls this much, almost every stock and most index funds fall too. Big drops like this feel scary, but they happen from time to time, and what matters is your time horizon.

title: Dow plunges about 1,800 points as Nasdaq enters a correction
summary: Yahoo Finance's live market coverage describes an AI trade meltdown on Thursday. The Dow lost roughly 1,800 points and the tech heavy Nasdaq fell into what traders call a correction.
why: A correction means a market index has dropped at least 10% from its recent high. It is a normal, if uncomfortable, part of investing, and the stocks that rose the most before often fall the most.

title: CNN ties the AI sell-off to the US midterm election results
summary: CNN reports that the midterm election results sent the AI trade into a tailspin, even though stocks had rallied the day before. Other outlets also point to worries about how much companies are spending on AI.
why: News can move prices in surprising ways, and the first explanation is not always the whole story. Reporters and analysts often disagree, so treat any single reason with care.
